verdict.rationale: Ironclad documents OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials Grant and per-client-app registration for API bearer tokens, which provides basic credential issuance per integration, but there is no evidence of granular OAuth scopes, role-based restrictions, or any agent-specific least-privilege token model — the API add-on appears to be enabled/disabled wholesale rather than scoped. Missing for 10: documented scope/permission granularity, agent-specific credential guidance, and any least-privilege configuration options beyond basic OAuth client registration.
